change: TradeEpisodeProjection.fees is null (with coverage.missing_refs 'fees', state partial) when fee evidence is absent/invalid; explicit 0 and nonzero remain known values; mixed missing/known fills stay null; authoritative trade_episode.updated fees resolves it. No fee derivation, no new owner/endpoint. Corrective: opened without fee is partial/missing; authoritative updated fees:null clears prior total; on load cached projections are re-derived in memory from retained raw events so legacy cached 0 without evidence reopens null and ordinary GET equals as_of_sequence replay. Reversal: a native closing fill without fee evidence marks the closed leg's fees null/missing (no proportional allocation or fill-fee sharing across legs). Cache-only: a stored projection with numeric fees 0 and no retained source events is exposed as null/missing fees on load (in memory only; stored files not rewritten); nonzero and event-backed explicit 0 preserved. Boolean fee values (false/true) are never coerced to 0/1: they are treated as missing evidence on opened, authoritative updated and native fill paths.
